description: Rebuild four runner and traversal games as shared Phaser 4 APK cartridges with dual editions, authenticated-host proof, and exact legacy cutover evidence.
deviation_notes: Activated after W2 completed the authenticated Advantage Games host. The wave consumes the existing gate-runner proof and preserves each legacy game's recognizable mechanic without renderer parity.

sprint.goal: Students can play four distinct runner/traversal APK cartridges through the shared authenticated arcade on desktop and touch devices.

stories.title: Cut over and verify the runner wave
